FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At The Deli Station, we specialize in providing a wide selection of fresh, high-quality sandwiches, deli meats, and complementary food items in a welcoming and efficient retail environment. Our operations focus on assembling pre-prepared ingredients using household-type appliances such as toasters and microwave ovens, which allow us to maintain a safe and compliant setup, minimizing fire risks. We also prioritize sourcing our ingredients from licensed and reputable vendors to ensure quality and traceability. Our team is trained in food safety protocols to prevent foodborne illnesses and ensure a safe dining experience for our customers. We operate in a retail space located in an area with high foot traffic, facilitating easy access for our customers while adhering to all local health department regulations. We do not offer catering services, serve alcoholic beverages, or have outdoor seating to manage our operational risks effectively. Our annual gross revenue remains below $500,000, which aligns with our preferred business model, allowing us to focus on providing exceptional service without the complexities associated with higher revenue operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 02/15/2023, Cause: Broken refrigeration unit leading to spoilage of perishable goods, Amount: $2,000, Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 2, Grade B, UL Listed Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system monitored 24/7 with perimeter fencing around the property.
